description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {C}{C}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
